summary: Pixel like button whose heart explodes and snaps back filled; press and hold opens four more reactions that the same pixels fly into.

attributes.name: count
attributes.description: Reaction count, rounded to a whole number of at least 0. Changing it updates the count; liking adds one to it.

events.name: react
events.description: Fires on like, unlike and when a reaction is picked. `reaction` is `Love`, `Star`, `Zap`, `Fire` or `Spark`.

methods.description: Likes or unlikes with the current reaction and adjusts the count by one.
Selects reaction 0 to 4 (`Love`, `Star`, `Zap`, `Fire`, `Spark`), marks it liked and moves focus to the button. Other values are ignored.

keyboard.action: Open the reaction palette and focus the current reaction.
Move focus between reactions, wrapping around.
Close the palette and return focus to the button.

accessibility: The main control is a native button with `aria-pressed` for the liked state, `aria-haspopup="menu"`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-label="Like. Press and hold for more reactions"`; after a pick the label starts with the reaction name.
The palette has `role="menu"` with `aria-label="Reactions"`; each reaction is a button with `role="menuitem"` and an `aria-label`. It closes when focus leaves the component.
The count is plain text without a live region.
motion: With reduced motion, pixels move straight to their new shape without exploding, the palette opens without its pop-in and the spark bursts are skipped.
notes: A press held for 430 ms opens the palette instead of toggling. Pressing anywhere else in the component, or moving focus out of it, closes it.
The button is a fixed 76 by 76px; the palette opens above it.

data.note: Pass the starting reaction count as `count`. Without it the count starts at 128.
